messages:
alex: Heads-up: supervisor FW staged to a subset of us-west1 racks (rack-f14, rack-f15). After the stage we saw BMC holdboot on ~12 nodes and latebind failures for GPU pods -> mass evictions. Suspect supervisor image toggled secureboot state on some BMCs. :grimacing:

opsbot: Alert: oob-supervisor-stage failed on rack-f14 at 10:32 UTC — 12 nodes unreachable for serial console.

mira: Can you paste the systemd journal snippet and the supervisor image tag? Also which rollback target?

alex: image=supervisor:v1.3.0-rc4
Logs:
```
May 15 10:31:58 host-bmc kernel: SecureBoot: TPM auth failed, setting SB state=1
May 15 10:32:01 bmc-supervisor[1]: holding boot on PCI reset; waiting for auth
May 15 10:32:05 oob-proxy: console lost, reconnect attempts=8
```

sre-oncall: Pausing rollout for remaining hosts. Initiating rollback command to supervisor:v1.2.3 on impacted racks. Rolling evictions to drain work and avoid double-alloc. Command sent.

alex: rollback command:
```
rbacctl image rollback --service=supervisor --to v1.2.3 --selectors rack=f14,f15
``` 

juan: Estimated customer-facing GPU evictions: ~120 GPUs across k8s pools, ~45m impact window. Ballpark cost delta ~ $2.5k/hr for spot reboots and scheduling churn. Tagging finance & capacity.

mira: Are any nodes hitting secureboot mismatch preventing netboot? If yes, we need manual power cycle and local IPMI clear.

alex: yes — 6 nodes show netboot blocked by secure-flag. Ops runbook step 3b: `ipmitool chassis bootparam set bootflag normal` + power cycle. I'll coordinate a small team to do remote cycles.

opsbot: Action: rollback started for 12 nodes. Progress: 4/12 complete.

sre-oncall: Update: rollback succeeded on racks f14/f15, secure flags cleared, serial consoles restored. GPU pools gradually returning; eviction tail end ~10m.

juan: Thx. Please make a short postmortem and add a rollout gating rule: supervisor releases must have a secureboot-attestation smoke test in us-west1 canary.

alex: Will file a short incident note and add gating rule. Extra follow-up: manual sweep of older racks for mixed supervisor versions.

mira: Thanks — please include exact node list and cost delta in the note. :thumbsup:
